I am a first-year **CS PhD** student at **Vanderbilt University** in the [Machine Automation, Perception, and Learning (MAPLE)](https://vu-maple-lab.github.io/) Lab. I am advised by **Dr. Jie Ying Wu**.

Previously, I was a **BS/MSE** student at **Johns Hopkins University**, where I double majored in **Biomedical Engineering** and **Computer Engineering**. There, I researched **surgical simulation** in deformable and occluded environments under the mentorship of **Dr. Adnan Munawar** and **Dr. Russell Taylor**.
